summary: Frontend-only testing of new Lead Pipeline Board (drag-and-drop status board). All 7 requested scenarios verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Board is the default view, all 6 columns with correct test-ids and live counts render; mouse drag-and-drop (dnd-kit PointerSensor with >6px activation) updates lead status, shows toast, persists after reload (confirmed via GET /api/leads), and updates column counts and the Overview stat-won-value. Clicking a card without dragging opens lead-detail-sheet. View toggle (board/table) is persisted in localStorage key 'bvvo_leads_view'. Search filter applies to board view. At 1920 desktop all 6 columns fit without any page-level horizontal overflow (board scrollWidth == clientWidth == 1336, page overflow 0). On 390 mobile, board scrolls horizontally internally (scrollWidth 1592 vs clientWidth 390) with page overflow 0.

test_results.six_columns_and_counts: PASS - board-column-{new,contacted,qualified,proposal-sent,won,lost} and board-column-count-* present; counts update live after drag
test_results.drag_updates_status_and_toast: PASS - dragging TEST_Charlie from New->Qualified: toast 'TEST_Charlie moved to Qualified' shown, column counts new 4->3 and qualified 0->1
test_results.status_persisted_after_reload: PASS - GET /api/leads shows status=Qualified; after reload card remains in Qualified column
test_results.click_without_drag_opens_sheet: PASS - lead-detail-sheet opens on simple click (dnd-kit distance:6px activation prevents accidental drag)
test_results.view_toggle_persisted: PASS - admin-leads-view-table switches to table, localStorage bvvo_leads_view='table', table persists after reload; admin-leads-view-board returns to board
test_results.filters_in_board: PASS - search 'TEST_Char' leaves only 1 matching card in the board
test_results.mobile_390_board_scrolls_no_page_overflo: PASS - board scrollWidth=1592 > clientWidth=390 (internal scroll), page overflow=0
test_results.overview_stat_won_updates: PASS - after moving TEST_Bravo to Won, stat-won-value=1 in Overview tab

critical_code_review_comments: LeadBoard.jsx: optimistic update is implemented in LeadsPanel.moveLead (good) with rollback on error. Clean.

DraggableCard applies {...listeners} on the wrapper AND an onClick to open sheet - works thanks to PointerSensor activationConstraint distance:6, so quick taps are treated as click. Confirmed in testing.
Minor: toast message uses `${lead.name} moved to ${status}` from the pre-move lead snapshot - works correctly.

Minor: board uses `grid-flow-col auto-cols-[minmax(250px,1fr)] xl:auto-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)]` which fits six columns on >=xl (>=1280px). Below xl desktops will still scroll horizontally; acceptable per spec which only requires 1920 to fit without scroll.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 leads (TEST_Alpha, TEST_Bravo, TEST_Charlie) via POST /api/leads during a previous script run; subsequent runs reused them (reset to status=New) and the final run DELETE'd all 3 (status 200). The one real lead 'Arc Track' was left untouched (verified still status=New).
context_for_next_testing_agent: LeadBoard feature fully working. Clean up TEST_* leads with DELETE /api/leads/{id} after tests. Do NOT delete the real 'Arc Track' lead.
